minor.issue: The guard only checks the DNS result of the first host. httpx is then called with follow_redirects=True and resolves the name again. So a public URL that 302-redirects to http://127.0.0.1 or 169.254.169.254, or a DNS-rebinding host, gets past the guard. Fix: follow_redirects=False and re-check each Location hop (max about 5), or use a transport that checks the connected IP.

The duplicate check is find_one then update_one, which is not atomic. Two concurrent POSTs arriving in the same few milliseconds could both start the LLM job (sequential double-clicks are handled; I confirmed only 1 roadmap was written). Use one find_one_and_update with the filter {kind, $or:[status!=running, started_at<now-5min]} and start the job only if it matched or upserted.

If the backend restarts mid-job (hot reload or deploy), the job stays 'running' until the 5-minute stale window ends. The UI then polls 60x4s (roadmap) or 45x3s (report) and stops silently, with no toast and no explanation. Show a 'still working, check back shortly' message when polling runs out.
This still counts only status=='confirmed', while erase and conflicts now use ACTIVE (which includes awaiting_approval and pending_payment). The list could show 0 upcoming while erase is blocked.

issues: Date and Start time use the browser's native <input type='date'/'time'> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover picker. This is inconsistent with the rest of the design system.

action_items: Close the SSRF redirect and DNS-rebinding gap in fetch_source (disable follow_redirects and re-validate each hop)
Make the _start job lock atomic with find_one_and_update
Show a message when roadmap or report polling times out or the job is stale
Align the customers list 'upcoming' stat with the ACTIVE statuses
Optional: replace the native date/time inputs in BookingDialog with the shadcn Calendar
